principle: Academic and standardized sources may anchor measurement or self-report lanes without converting symbolic interpretation into scientific evidence. Each instrument remains source-classed and separately admitted.

instruments.customerClaimBoundary: Imported results remain external profile results. A future first-party IPIP implementation must name the exact scale, scoring method, version and norming basis; it must not create an objective personality truth claim.
instruments.relationshipUseBoundary: Only same-provider/same-dimension comparison under PRF-W9 admitted rules; no compatibility percentage or outcome prediction.
instruments.professionalUseBoundary: May inform reflection or professional discussion after instrument-specific admission; it cannot independently establish a professional recommendation or diagnosis.

instruments.customerClaimBoundary: Raw task performance is not IQ, percentile, intelligence rank or cognitive diagnosis until a separately calibrated and normed authority exists.
instruments.relationshipUseBoundary: Only same task-family context may open an observation target; it may not rank intelligence or relationship quality.
instruments.professionalUseBoundary: Not a selection, diagnosis or professional competency instrument.

instruments.customerClaimBoundary: Optional successor only. No RIASEC result is generated or interpreted by PHI OS until the exact O*NET license path, implementation, attribution and scoring authority are separately admitted.
instruments.relationshipUseBoundary: No relationship comparison authority is admitted.
instruments.professionalUseBoundary: Potential future career-interest reflection only; not a job-fit guarantee or employment decision authority.

instruments.customerClaimBoundary: The OECD/INFE 2026 toolkit is an academic/professional reference for future financial-capability design. PHI OS does not reproduce its questionnaire or claim OECD scoring authority in Profile v1.
instruments.professionalUseBoundary: May inform future separately governed financial-capability instrument design; it does not replace professional financial planning authority.
